decidedBy: the protocol the user set on 2026-09-26: V1.4 the last development cycle; SRC-089 the last held-out; a gate failing on real generalization gaps goes to the verdict with its limitation stated
statement: the generic heading audit does not generalize across document genres. It is accurate inside the family it was developed on - financial statements whose headings are typographically marked (held-out F1 0.94 to 0.98) - and every new genre found conventions it did not read: body-size table labels (0.80), RFC numbering and back matter (0.91), decree articles bold only on their number (0). Hierarchy was never measurable

findings.finding: no generalization to new genres: each held-out of a new kind exposed new generic gaps (bucket B_NEW) that the previous development could not have seen
the ontology held: no held-out residual since V1.1 needed a new semantic category (C = 0); one document-specific residual (D) in the V1.1 held-out, none after
the source-fact layer can invalidate a measurement: SRC-053 read size 1 and no bold on every atom under PDF_SOURCE_FACTS_V1 (raw F1 0, kept); V2 and V3 fixed it and V3 read SRC-089 correctly
findings.evidence: SRC-053 classification; PDF_SOURCE_FACTS_V2/V3 freezes; SRC-089 measurementValidity

findings.finding: where the engine fails it mostly finds the heading's place but not its extent - a number without its title, a heading's lines apart - and it rarely invents headings: precision stayed at or above 0.96 on every valid held-out since V1.2 except SRC-054 (0.78, body-size tables) and SRC-089 (0 exact matches, 32 of 36 Gold headings found partially)
hierarchy is NOT_EVALUABLE: no level or parent is emitted and no occurrence Gold declares a hierarchy

limitations: eight held-outs, five of one family; each engine version met one or two held-outs; the reviewer who wrote the source-only Golds also designed the engine (not double-blind); every Gold decision without precedent was the user's
micro totals across the chain mix engine versions and are a summary of the study, not the accuracy of V1.4
V1.4's development fit is measured on documents it was developed on
occurrence membership and semantic axes only; no hierarchy, no visual binding
notClaimed: production readiness beyond a review-assisted audit of marked financial documents
